title: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255
text: Disclosures must be clear, conspicuous, placed above the fold, and use unambiguous terms like #Ad or #Sponsored.

title: ASCI Guidelines for Influencer Advertising
text: Promotional labels must be prominently visible across digital media platforms without requiring users to click See More.

title: Income Tax Act 1961 - Section 194J Professional Services
text: Tax deduction at source of 10% on payments for technical or professional fees exceeding threshold limits.
